_backup: Crafting tool item rows and every reference to them, captured before the tool ids were reorganised.
_scope: All crafting tools, across every profession - not cooking only. A tool is any item a recipe requires without consuming.
_howToRemap: Run `bun tools/tool-ids.js plan` after moving the ids. It resolves each recorded name to its new id and lists every reference still pointing at the old one.

tools.name: Soup Pot
tools.description:
An old hand-me-down utensil. Can be used to boil and stew a variety
of different soup-like dishes!

tools.name: Spoon
tools.description:
A fine cooking utensil. Some dishes require the ability to
stir the contents without your bare hands to produce sanitary results.

tools.name: Frying Pan
tools.description:
An old hand-me-down utensil. Can be used to saute, fry, or sear
a variety of different ingredients!

tools.name: Spatula
tools.description:
A fine cooking utensil. Some dishes require the finesse of
a turner like this to safely flip to the other side for even cooking.

tools.name: Hammer
tools.description:
A fine smithing tool. Some blueprints require a hammer
to do blacksmith things.

tools.name: Mitts
tools.description:
A fine smithing tool. Some blueprints call for steps that include
sticking your hands in the flames. These protect you from that.

tools.name: Gripper
tools.description:
A multi-purpose tool. It can be used to grab things from a safe distance,
or just lock things in place while you operate on them- food or weapons or whatever.

tools.name: Scissors
tools.description:
A common survival tool. You can't use this for fighting with, but
it would do well for precision-cutting fabric and the like while JAFTING.

tools.name: Eyeglass
tools.description:
A common survival tool. When things are tiny and/or hard to see,
use this and... well, you'll be able to see the tiny/hard-to-see things.

tools.name: Fountain Pen
tools.description:
A rare survival tool. Some say the pen is mightier than the sword,
but have you ever tried to literally combat a swordsman with a pen? At least it writes.

tools.name: Razor Sickle
tools.description:
A wickedly sharp scythe that will expertly cut lumber like nobodies business.
Don't bother trying to hack up enemies with it, you can't even equip it.

tools.name: Obliterator
tools.description:
Similar to what most know as a "blender" in function, except used for other products.
Throw anything into it, and it'll spit out a hyper-fine blended variant of the inputs- enemies not included.
